name: Glasgow Favourites Evening III 2025

venue.name: Learning and Teaching Building, Strathclyde University

information:
## Please read the [Favourites Competition Format tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/GlasgowFavEveningIII2025#54472-favourites-competition-format) before registering. You are only able to register for a few of the events available at this competition.

##### Please be aware that this is an evening competition and does not begin until 5:30pm

### This competition will run in 2 groups. You will compete in one group and run, judge, or scramble for the other group. You MUST be present for the entirety of both groups (i.e. 5:40pm - 8:50pm) otherwise you will not be allowed to compete.

Please make sure to read all the information in the tabs above.
